name: St. Anthony's Dining Room
description: St. Anthony's Dining Room has served San Francisco's Tenderloin neighborhood since 1950, providing free hot meals daily with dignity and respect to all who are hungry, no questions asked.
fullDescription: St. Anthony's Dining Room has served San Francisco's Tenderloin neighborhood since 1950, providing free hot meals daily with dignity and respect to all who are hungry, no questions asked.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free hot meals served 7 days a week
- Breakfast from 7am (dine-in or to go)
- Lunch 10am-1:30pm (dine-in)
- Afternoon hot meal to go at 2pm, Monday-Friday
- Weekly grocery "Farmers Market" for low-income Tenderloin residents and seniors
- No ID, referral, or questions asked
- Connections to other St. Anthony's services
howToGetIt: Simply show up during meal service hours at 121 Golden Gate Avenue, 1st Floor. No paperwork, ID, or appointment needed. All are welcome.
address: 121 Golden Gate Avenue, San Francisco, CA 94102
keywords: St. Anthony's, dining room, free hot meals, Tenderloin, San Francisco, soup kitchen, breakfast, lunch, no ID, walk-in
